FractionsWordProblems.title: Fraction Word Problems

typeA.statement: There are some items. <val1></val1> are one type and <val2></val2> are another. How many are there in total?

typeB.statement: You have <val1></val1> of a group. You remove <val2></val2>. How much is left?
typeB.hint: Subtract the second fraction from the first.

typeC.statement: <val1></val1> of a book with {total} pages are read. How many pages is that?

typeD.statement: I have {qty} packs of <unit></unit> {name}. How many {totalName} do I have?

typeE.statement: A group has {total} marbles. <val1></val1> are blue. How many are WRONG COLOR?
typeE.hint: Find the number of blue marbles and subtract from {total}.

typeF.statement: A balloon rises {ascend} m. Then descends <val1></val1> of the height. How high is it?

typeG.statement: After spending <val1></val1> of my money, I have {remainder} left. How much did I have?
typeG.hint: {remainder} is the remaining part. Divide {remainder} by {diffNum} and multiply by {den}.

FractionsWordProblems.operation_placeholder:
Total / Denom = Part
Part * Num = Result
